hook.say: South America is bigger than you think. Or is it? Five duels, three seconds each. Stay for the last one!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Argentina or India?
questions.fact: India is about 18% bigger than Argentina.
questions.sayAnswer: India! It is about eighteen percent bigger than Argentina.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Chile or Germany?
questions.fact: Chile is more than twice the size of Germany, and over 4,000 km long.
questions.sayAnswer: Chile! It is more than twice the size of Germany, and more than four thousand kilometres long.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Japan or Paraguay?
questions.fact: Paraguay is about 8% bigger than Japan.
questions.sayAnswer: Paraguay! It is about eight percent bigger than Japan.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Colombia or South Africa?
questions.fact: South Africa is about 7% bigger than Colombia.
questions.sayAnswer: South Africa! It is about seven percent bigger than Colombia.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Brazil or USA (lower 48)?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Brazil or the lower forty-eight U S states?
questions.fact: Brazil is about 5% bigger than the 48 contiguous US states.
questions.sayAnswer: Brazil! It is about five percent bigger than the forty-eight contiguous U S states.
